title: Automatic calibration with BT meter and manual calibration dialog
symptom: When using a Contour Next One BT meter with automatic calibration enabled, sometimes the message 'Use this measurement for calibration?' appears immediately after the measurement, instead of waiting 15 minutes. If the user selects 'No', automatic calibration still works fine. Additionally, during initial calibration of a new Libre sensor, the dialog asking for calibration values is overridden by the 'received new BT value' dialog, and the BT value is not used for initial calibration.
evidence_quote: But when the xDrip dialog is shown and you use the BT meter, then this dialog is overridden with the "received new BT value" one. This value is not used for initial calibration.
